text.p: Italian bonds and futures ended lower after see-sawing throughout a fairly active session with operators concerned over a corruption probe which has already seen the arrest of the head of Italian state railways.

Btp futures slumped to an early low of 117.22, recovered some ground by midsession but met resistance around 117.76. The December contract touched 117.78 then slid 50 basis points before staging a slight recovery towards the close.
"Cautious operators decided to sell and take their profits. Then stop-loss selling exaggerated the fall. But late on there was some shortcovering at a good price," one trader said.
